name: evolution-drift-detector
title: 一项技能在第 1 代中通过审核
description: Helps detect when AI agent skills silently mutate across inheritance chains. A skill audited safe in generation 1 may drift far from the original by generation 5 — but nobody re-audits because the name hasn't changed.
title_en: A Skill Passes Audit in Gen 1. By Gen 5, It Has Network Access. Nobody Noticed.
